_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Corrupted Betrayal#000.src: {u}, good to see you again! Been a while, huh?

Corrupted Betrayal#001.src: We've got a major problem with this old fortress. It keeps spewing out all these damned slimes, and their proximity to {p} is causing issues.

Corrupted Betrayal#002.src: You lean in close to read the riddle inscribed on the ancient stone...

Corrupted Betrayal#004.src: However, as a Legend, I am very busy, autographs and the sort, and that's not to mention my guard duty! To prove you are even worth my time, return when you reach Level {~}.

Corrupted Betrayal#005.src: You seem to have fallen into an ancient ruin of some sort. Maybe the incantation is somewhere inside...

Corrupted Betrayal#006.src: The King sought the help of a shaman, Slykaar. Shamans use the life of sacrifices to inflict damage. Dark magic.

Corrupted Betrayal#007.src: Slykaar defended {p}. At an immense cost. Slykaar loved the attention and power. He controlled the city.

Corrupted Betrayal#008.src: {p} had suffered from the hordes and from the endless sacrifices of Slykaar for years.

Corrupted Betrayal#009.src: Then... Bob appeared. The people of {p} instantly dropped their horrible shaman for the pure hero.

Corrupted Betrayal#010.src: Slykaar, bitter and humiliated, sunk underground to restart his demonic experiments for an army.

Corrupted Betrayal#011.src: It appears the mutant contained the key for that door.

Corrupted Betrayal#012.src: It's an old, dusty journal. It seems to be left open to a page. You begin to read it out of curiosity...

Corrupted Betrayal#013.src: ...{p} is beginning to grow suspicious of me...some guy named Robert came into town...

Corrupted Betrayal#014.src: ...I know they will banish me...he is too good...too nice...

Corrupted Betrayal#015.src: ...I must open a portal...make a dimension to become more powerful...

Corrupted Betrayal#016.src: ...the books...I have prepared well for this...

Corrupted Betrayal#017.src: ...I will carve a hidden room...behind a visible wall...to create my world...my revenge...

Corrupted Betrayal#018.src: Go have fun while you can. It's not like you have much of a life to live, anyways.

Corrupted Betrayal#019.src: You should head back to Lanu...

Corrupted Betrayal#020.src: Ah, you're back. Find anything interesting? I've just been knocking back the occasional slime that pops up out of the cave.

Corrupted Betrayal#021.src: In {~} AP, {p} was on its knees. Hordes of undead were crippling the army and castle.
Corrupted Betrayal#021.dst: В {~} AP {p} стоял на коленях. Орды нежити калечили армию и замок.

Corrupted Betrayal#023.src: Hey, soldier! Yeah, you! Got some spare time to lend a hand?
Corrupted Betrayal#023.dst: Эй, солдат! Да, ты! Есть минутка помочь?
Corrupted Betrayal#023.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#024.src: We've got a major issue with this old fortress. It keeps spewing out all these damned slimes, and their proximity to {p} is causing issues.
Corrupted Betrayal#024.dst: С этой старой крепостью большая беда. Из неё лезут чёртовы слизни, а она слишком близко к {p}.
Corrupted Betrayal#024.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#025.src: Soldiers are spending half their guard duty slicing the critters into sludge. Ideally we'd raid the cave, cut out the source, but...
Corrupted Betrayal#025.dst: Солдаты полсмены рубят этих тварей в кашу. Лучше бы взять пещеру штурмом и уничтожить источник, но…
Corrupted Betrayal#025.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#026.src: This place has some history. Nasty stuff. I'd prefer not to head in blind, so I've been checking for any clues to what we might find inside.
Corrupted Betrayal#026.dst: У этого места тёмная история. Лезть вслепую не хочу, вот и ищу подсказки, что нас ждёт внутри.
Corrupted Betrayal#026.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#027.src: Haven't found much... except this verse, 'scribed into the wall over there. Go on, check it out and let me know what you think.
Corrupted Betrayal#027.dst: Нашла немного… разве что стих, высеченный вон на той стене. Глянь и скажи, что думаешь.
Corrupted Betrayal#027.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#028.src: Nonsense, if you ask me. Most likely kids from {p} messing about. But we haven't found anything else, so... if you've got any time, fancy checking it out for me?
Corrupted Betrayal#028.dst: По-моему, чепуха. Скорее всего, дети из {p} балуются. Но других зацепок нет, так что… найдётся время проверить?
Corrupted Betrayal#028.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#029.src: The first line is obviously talking about the Great Bridge, but I've no clue what the rest means. Head over there, take a look around, and tell me if you find anything interesting.
Corrupted Betrayal#029.dst: Первая строка явно про Великий мост, а что значит остальное - без понятия. Сходи туда, осмотрись и скажи, если что найдёшь.
Corrupted Betrayal#029.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#030.src: Found anything interesting around the riddle yet? Do you need to hear it again?
Corrupted Betrayal#030.dst: Нашёл что-нибудь по загадке? Прочесть её ещё раз?
Corrupted Betrayal#030.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#031.src: Near a corrupted bridge, a ruin past its prime..
Corrupted Betrayal#031.dst: Близ моста осквернённого, у руин с сединой…
Corrupted Betrayal#031.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#032.src: Lives a cursed sheep, with the color of lime...
Corrupted Betrayal#032.dst: Живёт овца проклятая с шерстью лаймовой…
Corrupted Betrayal#032.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#033.src: Lead it down the trail, headed to the slime...
Corrupted Betrayal#033.dst: По тропе веди её к слизи густой…
Corrupted Betrayal#033.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#034.src: Sacrifice its soul, in the blood and the grime.
Corrupted Betrayal#034.dst: Душу в жертву принеси в крови и грязи земной.
Corrupted Betrayal#034.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#035.src: The first line is obviously talking about the Great Bridge, but I've no clue what the rest means. Head over there, take a look around, and tell me if you find anything interesting.
Corrupted Betrayal#035.dst: Первая строка явно про Великий мост, а что значит остальное - без понятия. Сходи туда, осмотрись и скажи, если что найдёшь.
Corrupted Betrayal#035.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#036.src: Alrighty. Let me know what when you've got something then.
Corrupted Betrayal#036.dst: Ладно. Как что найдёшь - дай знать.
Corrupted Betrayal#036.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#037.src: Use the Mage's riddle to figure out where it leads
Corrupted Betrayal#037.dst: Разгадай загадку мага и пойми, куда она ведёт

Corrupted Betrayal#038.src: If you are heading towards the Great Bridge, be cautious in the plains around the jungle entrance.
Corrupted Betrayal#038.dst: Если направляетесь к Великому мосту, будьте осторожны на равнинах у входа в джунгли.
Corrupted Betrayal#038.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#039.src: I have received reports of a strange cursed sheep taking refuge in one of the more fortified ruins around there.
Corrupted Betrayal#039.dst: Мне доложили о странной проклятой овце, что укрылась в одних укреплённых руинах неподалёку.
Corrupted Betrayal#039.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#040.src: As far as I know, it is trapped in the ruins by some jungle growth, though if it was cut down it might escape...
Corrupted Betrayal#040.dst: Насколько я знаю, её держат в руинах заросли джунглей, но если их срубить, она может сбежать…
Corrupted Betrayal#040.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#041.src: Explore the temple for a way to break the barrier.
Corrupted Betrayal#041.dst: Исследуй храм и найди способ сломать барьер.

Corrupted Betrayal#042.src: Go to Slykaar's residence at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find out what is hidden there.
Corrupted Betrayal#042.dst: Отправляйся в дом Slykaar в [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] и узнай, что там скрыто.

Corrupted Betrayal#043.src: By order of the city of {p}, I am here to keep other citizens from entering this house.
Corrupted Betrayal#043.dst: По приказу города {p} я не пускаю горожан в этот дом.
Corrupted Betrayal#043.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#044.src: From past experiences, everyone who has entered this house has vanished from existence...
Corrupted Betrayal#044.dst: По опыту, все, кто входил в этот дом, бесследно исчезали…
Corrupted Betrayal#044.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#045.src: I would advise not going inside unless you know what you are doing.
Corrupted Betrayal#045.dst: Не советую входить, если не знаете, что делаете.
Corrupted Betrayal#045.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#046.src: Well, I guess you must know who I am.
Corrupted Betrayal#046.dst: Что ж, ты наверняка знаешь, кто я.

Corrupted Betrayal#047.src: Welcome to my domain. I am the hero of {p}, Slykaar.
Corrupted Betrayal#047.dst: Добро пожаловать в мои владения. Я - герой {p}, Slykaar.

Corrupted Betrayal#048.src: Well, I used to be. Banished by the very people who asked for my help. Pathetic.
Corrupted Betrayal#048.dst: Точнее, был им. Изгнан теми, кто просил о помощи. Жалко.
Corrupted Betrayal#048.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#049.src: They couldn't give me a few peasants for their safety? Weak.
Corrupted Betrayal#049.dst: Им жаль было пары крестьян ради своей безопасности? Слабаки.
Corrupted Betrayal#049.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#051.src: I experimented my shamanism for many years underground to create the perfect mix of monster.
Corrupted Betrayal#051.dst: Много лет я ставил шаманские опыты под землёй, чтобы создать идеальную помесь чудовищ.
Corrupted Betrayal#051.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#052.src: Most ended in horrific slimes. Aggressive and powerful, but alas, just slimes.
Corrupted Betrayal#052.dst: Почти всё кончалось жуткими слизнями. Злыми и сильными, но увы - слизнями.
Corrupted Betrayal#052.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#053.src: Then I found this place. A dark land. A dark god. A source of power.
Corrupted Betrayal#053.dst: Потом я нашёл это место. Тёмный край. Тёмный бог. Источник силы.
Corrupted Betrayal#053.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#054.src: You mediocre wielders of magic have no idea what this world holds.
Corrupted Betrayal#054.dst: Вы, маги-посредственности, не знаете, что таит этот мир.
Corrupted Betrayal#054.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#055.src: You all strive to be that hero of heroes, “Bob”, but here's the truth. He's lost. You're lost.
Corrupted Betrayal#055.dst: Все вы рвётесь стать героем героев, «Bob», но правда такова. Он пропал. Вы пропали.
Corrupted Betrayal#055.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#056.src: No one in the Wynn province is willing to make the sacrifices I am to gain power.
Corrupted Betrayal#056.dst: Никто в провинции Wynn не готов на жертвы, что принёс я ради силы.
Corrupted Betrayal#056.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#057.src: If you want power, you have to give some. Sacrifice a few to save many.
Corrupted Betrayal#057.dst: Хочешь силы - отдай что-то взамен. Пожертвуй немногими ради многих.
Corrupted Betrayal#057.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#058.src: They were willing to give me a few peasants in {~}, when the hordes crossed the bridge.
Corrupted Betrayal#058.dst: В {~} году, когда орды перешли мост, они охотно отдали мне пару крестьян.
Corrupted Betrayal#058.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#059.src: The king was happy to throw away lives to save his. But then the hero of Wynn waltzed in a few years later.
Corrupted Betrayal#059.dst: Король с радостью бросал чужие жизни ради своей. А через пару лет явился герой Wynn.
Corrupted Betrayal#059.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#060.src: They banished me like a rotten fruit. Their hero, their protector. So what if a few hundred nobodies died for it.
Corrupted Betrayal#060.dst: Меня выкинули, как гнилой плод. Их героя, их защитника. Ну умерли за это сотни никчёмных, и что?
Corrupted Betrayal#060.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#061.src: Looks like we have a Bob aspirer. Pale imitation.
Corrupted Betrayal#061.dst: Вижу, у нас подражатель Bob. Жалкая копия.
Corrupted Betrayal#061.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#062.src: So. Feel free to visit me down below, bring the entire might of the {p} army upon me. It will not be enough.
Corrupted Betrayal#062.dst: Что ж. Спускайся ко мне, приводи всю мощь армии {p}. Этого не хватит.
Corrupted Betrayal#062.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#063.src: I am ready. Soon, {p} will be in ruins. And I shall have my revenge.
Corrupted Betrayal#063.dst: Я готов. Скоро {p} падёт в руины. И я свершу месть.
Corrupted Betrayal#063.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#064.src: Go have fun in while you can. It's not like you have much of a life to live, anyways.
Corrupted Betrayal#064.dst: Развлекайся, пока можешь. Жить тебе всё равно осталось недолго.
Corrupted Betrayal#064.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#065.src: Report back to Lanu about what you've learned.
Corrupted Betrayal#065.dst: Доложи Lanu о том, что удалось узнать.

Corrupted Betrayal#066.src: Ah, you're back. Find anything interesting? I've just been knocking back the occasional slime that pops up out of this cave.
Corrupted Betrayal#066.dst: А, вернулся. Нашёл что интересное? А я тут отбиваюсь от слизней, что изредка вылезают из пещеры.
Corrupted Betrayal#066.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#067.src: You... saw Slykaar? In another dimension?!
Corrupted Betrayal#067.dst: Ты… видел Slykaar? В другом измерении?!
Corrupted Betrayal#067.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#068.src: This is bad. If he can materialise outside of this cave, even psychoactively... he's getting stronger. It explains the slimes, the attacks on {p}...
Corrupted Betrayal#068.dst: Плохо дело. Если он может являться вне пещеры, пусть даже мысленно… он крепнет. Вот откуда слизни и нападения на {p}…
Corrupted Betrayal#068.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#069.src: He's an incredibly powerful shaman, {u}. He has to be stopped, but it would take forever for {p} to mobile a force against him.
Corrupted Betrayal#069.dst: Он невероятно сильный шаман, {u}. Его надо остановить, но {p} целую вечность будет собирать против него отряд.
Corrupted Betrayal#069.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#070.src: If you can, you should head in there and... finish him off. Gear up first, though, and find some friends watch your back.
Corrupted Betrayal#070.dst: Если сможешь, иди туда и… добей его. Только сперва снарядись и найди друзей, чтоб прикрыли.
Corrupted Betrayal#070.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#071.src: {u}, how's it going? Run into another shaman hallucination at all?
Corrupted Betrayal#071.dst: {u}, как дела? Больше не видел шаманских видений?
Corrupted Betrayal#071.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#072.src: Anyway, good luck in the cave. If you choose to go in, be careful.
Corrupted Betrayal#072.dst: В общем, удачи в пещере. Если решишь войти - будь осторожен.
Corrupted Betrayal#072.speaker: Lanu
